an7.25:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] satta vo bhikkhave, aparihānīye dhamme desissāmi,
an7.25:1.3: katame ca bhikkhave, satta aparihānīyā dhammā.
an7.25:1.4: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū saddhā bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.25:2.6: paññāvanto bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.25:3.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, ime satta aparihānīyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti. imesu ca sattasu aparihānīyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
